text:
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be carried out 
on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block
The first draft 
initiated by eng. Mohamed Salah El-Din Badawy, reviewed by eng. Hassan el refaie 
general director, tested by eng. Ahmed Abdel Halim, revised by EDEPC inspection & 
quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Nagar accepted by eng. Samir Abd El 
Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and approved by eng. Mohamed El Sarag: head 
sector of Damietta PS
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
Isolate all AC supplies, auxiliary supplies and the 
battery (open isolator, remove battery fuses or remove a battery link) before 
working on the inverter and never handle a component or assembly without 
personally confirming that no voltage is applied or present.
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the
 personal protective equipment as 
 safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Isolate all AC supplies, auxiliary supplies and the 
battery (open isolator, remove battery fuses or remove a battery link) before 
working on the inverter and never handle a component or assembly without 
personally confirming that no voltage is applied or present.

Complete maintenance tool set
Multimeter
Air blower
Contact resistance tester
Cleaning solvent
Megger (500 5000) volt
